panels.title: Pool Nodes by Tenant / Pool / Role
DuckDB Memory Used per Node
panels.description: Buffer-manager memory in use per node, summed across consumers (base tables, hash tables, parquet readers, ...). Scraped from duckdb_memory() by the manager's health probe.

panels.title: Spill to Disk (Bytes) per Node
panels.description: Total size of live spill files per node (duckdb_temporary_files()). Non-zero means queries exceed the node's memory budget and are spilling to disk.

panels.title: Spill Files per Node
panels.description: Count of live spill files per node. A rising count tracks queries that overflow the memory budget onto disk.

panels.title: DuckDB Temp Storage per Node
panels.description: Buffer-manager temp storage per node (duckdb_memory() temporary_storage_bytes).

panels.title: Maintenance Runs by Result (rate)
panels.description: Managed-maintenance run rate by result (succeeded / failed / partial).

panels.title: Column-Policy Catalog Lookups by Result (rate)
panels.description: Column-policy catalog lookups by result (hit / miss / error).

panels.title: Table Repeat Rate
panels.description: Share of routed table references that landed on a node already holding that table (cache-aware routing benefit).

panels.title: Placement Switch (Scatter) Rate
panels.description: Share of placement decisions that moved a table to a different node (scatter). Lower is stickier.

panels.title: Placement Decisions by Outcome
panels.description: Placement-decision outcomes: claim / sticky-fresh / sticky-stale / overflow-* / pinned-* / no-refs-fallback / not-eligible / flag-off.

panels.title: Load Ratio (target < loadCapFactor)
panels.description: Chosen-node in-flight over pool average. Should stay under the configured loadCapFactor.
